name: daily-tips
title: Daily Tips
description: Shows a short writing tip with every post in the REST API, on the dashboard and in the editor (with a Writing sidebar that follows what you type and a Words column in the posts list), serves a random tip at /wp-json/daily-tips/v1/tip, and adds a Tips post type for your own.

sections.title: Where tips appear
sections.description: Tips show on the dashboard and in the editor’s Post tab.

sections.title: Your tips
sections.description: Add your own tips beside the ones that come with the plugin.

settings.name: show_in_posts
settings.label: Add a tip to posts in the REST API
settings.description: Adds a daily_tip field to /wp/v2/posts responses.

settings.name: accent
settings.label: Widget colour
settings.description: The stripe beside the tip on the dashboard.
